note: Homepage on the components/site/v3 barrel, Broadside register (Matt approved the full rebuild 2026-08-27; the hero stays). index.html is the retired KB mockup, kept as history, not the visual target. FOUR patterns — the homepage is NOT in the place-family fifth-pattern exception: Stage (the Bend flyover hero over the Old Mill still; 0af80821 keeps the drone footage, not the rejected 3D-tiles render) · Field (the curated listed set, map plotting the same set, count = the leftover region row) · Ledger twice, non-adjacent (towns with the D21 remainder note; featured communities printing the index count) · Instrument (the market question + leftover KPI row + median-close year overlay, then the property-type run as the enumerated tail of the same grouping, the ZIP/plat form). The absence branch swaps the Instrument for a Quiet stating the miss.
